\item \textit{Notes:} Every split is forward: the estimation sample, a gap and the validation sample at the end of the rolling window $\mathcal W_t$ (Section~\ref{sec:rh_methods_tuning}), so the out-of-sample period is never used for a choice. Re-estimated and re-selected every: the spacing of successive estimations and hyperparameter selections, in the units of the panel; $\mathcal C$: the grid neighbors that challenge the selected penalty. Criteria are computed on the scale of $\tilde y_{t,i}$ unless QLIKE is named; all random seeds are fixed. Optuna starts a new search at each re-selection; the pooled trees use one fixed configuration per method (for LightGBM and XGBoost, single arms of a 20-configuration development bank), re-estimated at every interval (part of them only every 10th).
